# AegisLex — Phase 3: Accessibility Report

## Audit Scope

Verified that localization changes do not break and where possible improve:
ARIA labels, screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, focus management, dashboard usability.

## Changes That Improve Accessibility

### 1. Header action buttons — ARIA labels added
Before:
```html
<a routerLink="/app/chat" class="btn-primary">
  <span class="material-icons">smart_toy</span>
  Ask Saul
</a>
```
After:
```html
<a routerLink="/app/chat" class="btn-primary"
   [attr.aria-label]="lang.t('dashboard.ask_saul')">
  <span class="material-icons">smart_toy</span>
  {{ lang.t('dashboard.ask_saul') }}
</a>
```
Both the visible text and the aria-label are now localized together. Screen readers in Arabic will announce the correct Arabic label.

### 2. Saul "Start Chat" button — dedicated ARIA label
The start chat button now has a more descriptive ARIA label:
```html
[attr.aria-label]="lang.t('dashboard.saul.start_chat_aria')"
// EN: "Start chat with Saul AI"
// AR: "ابدأ محادثة مع سول الذكي"
```

### 3. Material Icons marked `aria-hidden`
All decorative `<span class="material-icons">` elements within interactive elements now carry `aria-hidden="true"`, preventing screen readers from announcing icon names like "arrow_forward" redundantly.

### 4. Stat card icons marked `aria-hidden`
```html
<div class="stat-card__icon" ... [attr.aria-hidden]="true">
```
The icon container is decorative; the label below it conveys the meaning.

### 5. Donut SVG — localized aria-label
```html
<svg ... [attr.aria-label]="lang.t('dashboard.chart.cases_by_status')">
```
Screen readers will announce the chart title in the active language.

### 6. Cases "View all" link — aria-label added
```html
[attr.aria-label]="lang.t('dashboard.cases.view_all')"
```

### 7. Quick upload zone — aria-label added
```html
[attr.aria-label]="lang.t('dashboard.upload.cta')"
```

## No Regressions Found

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| Keyboard navigation (links, buttons) | ✓ Unchanged |
| Focus order | ✓ Unchanged — no DOM reordering |
| Screen reader text (content) | ✓ Improved — Arabic text now correct |
| Screen reader decorative icons | ✓ Improved — aria-hidden added |
| `lang` attribute on `<html>` | ✓ Already set by LanguageService (`lang="ar"` or `lang="en"`) |
| `dir` attribute on `<html>` | ✓ Already set by LanguageService |
| Loading skeleton accessibility | ✓ Unchanged — purely visual, no semantic content |
| Empty state link | ✓ Preserved — now localized text |

## WCAG Compliance Notes

- Color contrast: No color values changed in this pass — existing contrast ratios preserved
- Text resize: `clamp()` font sizes in SCSS unchanged
- Focus indicators: CSS focus styles unchanged
- Interactive element labels: Improved (see items 1–7 above)
